message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Sun (孙某某) on July 3, 2014, after drinking, angry because village resident Zhang (张某某) didn't return home, he climbed over wall into his courtyard, smashed TV, audio, clothes, some burned, etc. Zhang came home and tried to stop, Sun punched him in the face. Damage value 1580 yuan. Later on Oct 10, Sun sent message threatening to jump into his house; Zhang called his brother-in-law, who called police. After case, they reached compensation agreement, Sun compensated and got victim's forgiveness.

So crimes: intentional damage to property (故意毁坏财物) and intentional injury (故意伤害). The punching caused injury? It says "拳打到脸部". No mention of injury severity, but likely minor. Could be "故意伤害". Also the property damage is intentional. So charges: 故意毁坏财物;故意伤害.

Check list: "故意毁坏财物" and "故意伤害". Yes.

Any other? Threatening via message maybe "寻衅滋事"? But main acts are property damage and assault. So answer: 故意毁坏财物;故意伤害.
